effects: The signer sends `assets` USDC to the vault (OZ ERC4626._deposit safeTransferFrom caller -> vault).
The vault mints shares, computed from storage at a floor rate, to `receiver`; there is no minimum shares bound.
formats.shown: Intent "Deposit" with the USDC amount, the share ticker 9SUSDC11Core and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many shares the receiver gets; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` Case 0: signer receives 18.291584545376568155 9SUSDC11Core; the screen shows only 'Share ticker: 9SUSDC11Core'.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor: ERC4626 deposit has no minShares parameter to display.

findings.title: deposit intent "Deposit" names no asset and no vault share; the share ticker sits alone as a raw field.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit USDC for 9SUSDC11Core shares" and relabel the field "Receive shares".

cases.notes: USDC out 19.50368 shown exactly. 18.29 shares in: asset and receiver shown, amount not shown (storage-derived).

effects: The signer sends USDC to the vault; the amount is computed from `shares` at a ceiling rate from storage, and no maximum bound exists.
The vault mints exactly `shares` vault shares to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Intent "Mint", the deposit asset ticker USDC without an amount, the exact shares minted, and the share receiver.

findings.title: mint does not show how much USDC leaves the signer; the vault derives it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` Case 1: signer sends 0.000002 USDC; screen shows 'Deposit asset: USDC' with no amount.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor: ERC4626 mint has no maxAssets parameter. A label such as "Pays (USDC, amount set by vault rate)" can say the amount is not fixed.

findings.title: mint intent "Mint" does not say that the signer pays USDC into the vault.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: "intent": "Mint"; super._deposit pulls `assets` of USDC from _msgSender(). Reader case 1 was unsure how much USDC leaves.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit USDC to mint 9SUSDC11Core shares".

cases.notes: Signer's only effect is 2 wei USDC out; screen names USDC but no amount. Shares go to 0xdEaD, which the screen shows correctly.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns vault shares from `owner`; the number is computed at a ceiling rate from storage, and no maximum bound exists.
When the caller is not the owner, the caller's share allowance from the owner is spent.
The vault sends exactly `assets` USDC to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Intent "Withdraw", the exact USDC amount, the receiver and the owner of the shares.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many shares the owner burns; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` Case 2: signer burns 21.552436790523114117 9SUSDC11Core, not on screen.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor: ERC4626 withdraw has no maxShares parameter.

findings.title: withdraw intent "Withdraw" does not say that vault shares are burned for USDC.
findings.evidence: descriptor withdraw format: "intent": "Withdraw"; reader case 2 was unsure what gets given up from the position.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Withdraw USDC by burning vault shares".

cases.notes: USDC in 22.645969 to signer shown exactly. Share burn understood as the position shrinking; the share amount is not shown.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` vault shares from `owner`, spending the caller's allowance when the caller is not the owner.
The vault sends USDC to `receiver`; the amount is computed at a floor rate from storage, and no minimum bound exists.
formats.shown: Intent "Redeem", the exact shares redeemed, the receiver and the owner; no field names the asset received.

findings.title: redeem never names USDC as the asset the receiver gets, though mint shows it as a constant.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem format fields: shares, receiver, owner only; no `$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker` field. Case 3: signer receives 24.511701 USDC; reader guessed 'likely USDC, going by the name'.
findings.fix: Add {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} and change the intent to "Redeem shares for USDC".

findings.title: redeem does not show how much USDC arrives; the vault computes it from storage with no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` Case 3: 24.511701 USDC in, amount not on screen.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor: ERC4626 redeem has no minAssets parameter.

cases.notes: 22.984294940865405567 shares out shown exactly. USDC in: the asset is not named and the amount is not shown; the reader guessed the asset from the ticker.
